title: Where Does Your Money Actually Go?

lines.text: Ever wonder where your money actually goes?
lines.caps: Ever wonder | where your money | actually goes?

lines.text: You work forty hours feeling like an absolute boss,
lines.caps: You work | forty hours | feeling like | an absolute boss,

lines.text: and you strut into the store ready to spend.
lines.caps: and you strut | into the store | ready to spend.

lines.text: You reach into your pocket, pull out your leather wallet,
lines.caps: You reach | into your pocket, | pull out | your leather wallet,

lines.text: and there is nothing inside except a solitary spiderweb.
lines.caps: and there is | nothing inside | except | a solitary spiderweb.

lines.text: And before you can even blink,
lines.caps: And before | you can even blink,

lines.text: your last dollar bill sprouts wings and flies away forever.
lines.caps: your last dollar bill | sprouts wings | and flies away | forever.

lines.text: Leaving you broke until next payday.
lines.caps: Leaving you broke | until next payday.
